facts.fact: Cameroon's PATNUC project unit at MINPOSTEL invited four shortlisted firms on 29 February 2024 to bid, by 2 April 2024, to update the 'plan numerique 2020'.
Cameroon's PATNUC project unit at MINPOSTEL, financed by IDA credit 69870-CM, sought a consultant to update the 2020 digital plan with accessibility and gender-equality considerations.
